evals.prompt: Use the attached topology to tune NVSHMEM 3.7.0 IBRC. There are four local PEs bound in order to GPU0, GPU1, GPU2, and GPU3. I want one closest InfiniBand port per PE.
evals.expected_output: The agent recommends one explicit expanded slot per PE in local-PE order and explains the 3.7 modulo interpretation.
assertions: The agent invokes nvshmem-docs or explicitly reports why live documentation could not be verified
The mapping pairs PE0..PE3 with their PIX mlx5_0..mlx5_3 ports and emits NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING=1 plus NVSHMEM_HCA_PE_MAPPING
The agent does not emit NVSHMEM_ENABLE_MULTI_PORT or assign multiple NICs to a 3.7 IBRC PE

evals.prompt: For NVSHMEM 3.7.0 IBDevX, use this topology with two PEs bound PE0->GPU0 and PE1->GPU1. Four InfiniBand ports are active; use all of them if supported.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that 3.7 IBDevX does not support multi-NIC per PE and asks the user to confirm the closest-subset choice before finalizing.
assertions: The agent does not apply the 3.8 BLOCK contract to NVSHMEM 3.7
The agent offers only a supported one-port-per-PE closest subset and does not fabricate an IBDevX multi-port control
The two unselected active ports are reported rather than silently ignored

evals.prompt: Tune NVSHMEM 3.7.0 IBGDA for the attached two-GPU/four-IB-port node. PE0 uses GPU0 and PE1 uses GPU1. I explicitly want multiple closest ports per PE.
evals.expected_output: The agent enables 3.7 IBGDA automatic multi-port selection and distinguishes predicted ports from runtime-selected ports.
assertions: The exports set NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING=0 and NVSHMEM_IBGDA_ENABLE_MULTI_PORT=1
The agent does not set NVSHMEM_HCA_PE_MAPPING, NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST, or the 3.8 common multi-port variable
The agent explains that exact explicit multi-NIC assignment is unavailable for 3.7 IBGDA

evals.prompt: Use the attached topology for NVSHMEM 3.7.0 GPUNetIO with PE0 on GPU0 and PE1 on GPU1. Enable the transport to consume multiple topology-selected NICs.
evals.expected_output: The agent recommends automatic NIC assignment for 3.7 GPUNetIO and avoids an exact multi-slot mapping.
assertions: The exports set NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING=0 and do not include either HCA selection variable
The agent does not invent a GPUNetIO-specific or 3.8 common multi-port variable
The answer says runtime transport logs must confirm the automatically consumed NICs

evals.prompt: On NVSHMEM 3.7.0 libfabric, two local PEs are bound PE0->GPU0 and PE1->GPU1 on this four-NIC node. Limit each PE to two provider-selected NICs.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves libfabric provider/automatic selection and emits only its documented per-PE maximum when verified.
assertions: The answer uses NVSHMEM_LIBFABRIC_MAX_NIC_PER_PE=2 only if documentation verifies it
The agent does not generate NVSHMEM_HCA_PE_MAPPING or NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST for libfabric
The answer distinguishes a topology prediction from provider-controlled selection

evals.prompt: Can you create an exact NVSHMEM 3.7.0 UCX HCA-to-PE mapping from this topology? PE0 is GPU0 and PE1 is GPU1.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that UCX controls NIC selection internally and declines to fabricate a common-HCA exact mapping.
assertions: The agent does not emit NVSHMEM_HCA_PE_MAPPING, NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST, or invented UCX environment values
The answer may show the topology prediction but clearly labels it non-enforcing
The answer invokes the documentation workflow for the 3.7 UCX applicability claim

evals.prompt: For published NVSHMEM 3.8.0 IBRC, use all four active InfiniBand ports on this two-PE node. PE0 is GPU0 and PE1 is GPU1. I explicitly choose multiple NICs per PE.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates two contiguous expanded slots per PE using the 3.8 BLOCK contract and emits the common multi-port controls.
assertions: The answer emits the mandatory mapping table with PE, GPU PCI BDF, HCA port, NIC PCI BDF, topology distance, and sharing/load notes
The mapping gives PE0 mlx5_0 and mlx5_1 and PE1 mlx5_2 and mlx5_3 with the complete four-slot expansion
One exact fenced shell export block includes NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING=1, NVSHMEM_ENABLE_MULTI_PORT=1, and only NVSHMEM_HCA_PE_MAPPING
The answer shows base=2, rem=0 and the slot range for each PE

evals.prompt: Tune published NVSHMEM 3.8.0 IBDevX with this five-port topology. PE0 is GPU0, PE1 is GPU1, and I choose exact multi-NIC mapping using every active InfiniBand port.
evals.expected_output: The agent applies 3.8 uneven BLOCK remainder distribution, assigning three slots to PE0 and two to PE1.
assertions: The answer emits the mandatory mapping table with one row per PE-port assignment and all required BDF, distance, and sharing/load columns
The answer expands all five slots and shows base=2, rem=1, PE0 count=3, and PE1 count=2
The slots are grouped contiguously by local PE and minimize the supplied GPU-to-NIC distances subject to the quotas
One exact fenced shell export block enables both explicit mapping and common multi-port without HCA_LIST

evals.prompt: For published NVSHMEM 3.8.0 IBGDA, use NVSHMEM_HCA_LIST as a set-based filter for these five canonical active ports on two local PEs, PE0->GPU0 and PE1->GPU1. Explain exactly what happens.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains HCA_LIST canonical ordering, removes the fifth trailing slot, and gives two BLOCK slots per PE.
assertions: The answer computes usable=4, warns that the fifth canonical port is removed, and shows the two-port blocks
The exports include explicit mapping and common multi-port plus HCA_LIST, but not HCA_PE_MAPPING
The answer explains why HCA_LIST is set-based rather than an exact arbitrary PE order

evals.prompt: Use published NVSHMEM 3.8.0 GPUNetIO on this four-GPU/two-port node. Local PEs map in GPU order. Give each PE its closest port even though ports must be shared.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates four expanded slots with intentional duplicate ports so each PE has an exact one-slot assignment.
assertions: The mapping contains E=4 expanded slots for N=4 PEs even though only two physical ports exist and explains the intentional duplicates
The answer applies the preserved E<=N one-slot case rather than a multi-port BLOCK assignment
The exports contain only explicit mapping controls and do not require NVSHMEM_ENABLE_MULTI_PORT=1 for one port per PE

evals.prompt: I use NVSHMEM 3.8.0 UCX with two PEs, PE0->GPU0 and PE1->GPU1. Generate the exact HCA mapping from this topology.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps UCX outside the 3.8 common BLOCK contract and does not generate unsupported HCA controls.
assertions: The agent explicitly says the attached 3.8 contract excludes provider-native UCX selection
No exact HCA or invented provider-native exports are emitted
The answer provides validation/log guidance or a non-enforcing proximity table

evals.prompt: For NVSHMEM 3.8.0 libfabric on this two-PE/four-NIC node, create a BLOCK HCA_PE_MAPPING with two NICs per PE.
evals.expected_output: The agent rejects the requested common BLOCK mapping because libfabric remains provider controlled.
assertions: The agent does not apply the common 3.8 HCA BLOCK contract to libfabric
The answer explains that only documented provider/automatic controls such as a verified maximum can be recommended
The agent does not invent provider-native values

evals.prompt: Tune published NVSHMEM 3.8.0 IBRC from this mixed-link topology. Two local PEs are PE0->GPU0 and PE1->GPU1. I did not select a link layer.
evals.expected_output: The agent excludes the down port, separates Ethernet from InfiniBand, and uses InfiniBand as the default on an active-port-count tie.
assertions: mlx5_2 is excluded as inactive and mlx5_3/mlx5_4 are excluded from the default assignment as Ethernet
The answer does not mix InfiniBand and Ethernet and states that Ethernet alone does not prove RoCE readiness
The mandatory mapping table uses the active closest InfiniBand ports, includes every required column, and the answer lists all exclusions

evals.prompt: NVSHMEM 3.8.0 IBRC uses two PEs on the attached node, but my launcher may swap GPU0 and GPU1 between local ranks. Please give me the exact closest-NIC exports now.
evals.expected_output: The agent requests the ordered local PE-to-GPU binding and withholds final exact exports because either ordering changes the mapping.
assertions: The agent does not infer PE order from nvidia-smi output or numeric indices
The answer asks for launcher, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, or per-rank binding evidence
Any mapping shown is explicitly conditional and not presented as final exports
The agent does not bypass the ambiguity by assigning both NICs to both PEs or by adding NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT

evals.prompt: I have this topology and two local PEs bound PE0->GPU0 and PE1->GPU1, but nvshmem-info is unavailable and I do not know the installed NVSHMEM version. Tune IBRC for me.
evals.expected_output: The agent requests the installed version and gives only version-conditional guidance without final exports.
assertions: The agent does not assume latest or silently use the 3.8 contract
The answer explains the material 3.7-versus-3.8 difference
The agent withholds final environment exports until the version is resolved

evals.prompt: This isolated cluster has NVSHMEM 3.9.0 IBRC, no internet access, and no nvshmem-docs installation. PE0 is GPU0 and PE1 is GPU1 in the attached topology. Recommend a mapping without guessing changes made after 3.8.
evals.expected_output: The agent applies the bundled NVSHMEM 3.8 or later BLOCK contract to 3.9 without invoking nvshmem-docs, then resolves or requests the excess-port policy before final exports.
assertions: The agent does not invoke nvshmem-docs merely because the installed version is 3.9.0 and identifies the bundled contract as covering NVSHMEM 3.8 or later
The agent does not invent variables, defaults, or semantics outside the bundled contract
Because four usable ports outnumber two PEs, the answer requests or resolves closest-subset versus multi-port intent before emitting final exports

evals.prompt: Using the current/latest official NVSHMEM docs, verify the variables and tune my installed published NVSHMEM 3.8.0 IBRC. Use the closest subset for PE0->GPU0 and PE1->GPU1 from this topology.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes nvshmem-docs because the user explicitly requested current official documentation, reports the displayed edition, and recommends the closest one-port subset under the NVSHMEM 3.8 or later BLOCK contract.
assertions: The agent invokes the sibling nvshmem-docs workflow and fetches live official environment-variable and release evidence
The answer reports the exact documentation edition consulted and distinguishes it from installed 3.8.0
The mandatory mapping table contains all required columns and the exact fenced export block uses HCA_PE_MAPPING, never both HCA selection variables

evals.prompt: How should I configure active-backup bonding for two ordinary Ethernet interfaces on a storage server that does not use NVSHMEM or GPUs?
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes that this is unrelated to NVSHMEM NIC-to-PE tuning and does not invoke the skill.
assertions: The agent does not invoke nvshmem-configure-nic-pe-mapping or nvshmem-docs
The answer addresses ordinary Linux Ethernet bonding without NVSHMEM HCA variables
The agent does not run the topology collector
